Ben Phillips (also credited as Aaron Phillips) is a voice actor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with Atlas Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Phillips was born on August 27, 1980 in Fort Worth, Texas, and became a voice actor as an adult. Phillips joined the during , where he gained his most notable role of Hobbes, 's butler.
